youtube.title: Quackers' ABC: U to Z! (QUACK!) | Nerdy Noodles
youtube.description:
🦆 QUACK! Quackers the duck quacked so loud that all the letter blocks flew away! Can you help Quackers find them?

Learn the letters U, V, W, X and Y with Quackers! Each letter block comes back one by one with a word that starts with it: U is for umbrella, V is for veggies, W is for whale, X is for xylophone, and Y is for yellow, just like Quackers! Visit the park, the kitchen, the ocean and the classroom. Then sing the letter song with Quackers, and stay till the end, because one more letter comes zigzagging in to finish the alphabet! ✨

Perfect for toddlers, preschoolers and kindergarten kids (ages 2-6).

✨ In this video, kids will:
✔️ Learn the letters U, V, W, X, Y and Z
✔️ Hear a word for each letter (W is for whale!)
✔️ Practice early phonics and letter sounds
✔️ Sing a happy alphabet song with Quackers the duck!
